entities.summary: Matthew Russell Downs Sr. is an American former professional baseball infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants and Houston Astros. He bats and throws right-handed. He stands 6 feet 1 inch (1.85 m) tall and weighs 190 pounds (86 kg).
